Eight-negative uncorrected classification minimizes `−s_pos + log(exp(s_pos)+Σ exp(s_neg))`: nine-way cross-entropy, distinct from eight independent binary losses. Proposal-corrected sampled softmax adjusts logits using sampling probabilities/expected counts. For eight unique negatives uniformly drawn from M eligible items, each negative’s inclusion probability is 8/M; an importance estimate of the eligible negative partition weights its exponential by M/8, while the guaranteed positive retains weight 1. Uniform correction therefore does not simply cancel between positive and negatives. Finite-sample log-partition estimates remain biased; excluding other training positives also prevents estimating the unrestricted full-catalog partition. [TensorFlow sampling reference](https://www.tensorflow.org/extras/candidate_sampling.pdf)

Define exclusions as the user’s complete training-item set, including interactions later than the current training position. Preserve repeated interaction events in the chronological sequence and positive targets; deduplicate only the exclusion set. Repeated items remain valid positive targets but never sampled negatives. This is training-wide exclusion, a different policy from prefix-only exclusion; it must not inspect validation/test labels. The published sequential [sampler implementation](https://github.com/kang205/SASRec/blob/master/sampler.py) illustrates this distinction without requiring any backbone change.

A derived rejection-free implementation: with zero-based catalog IDs, sort unique excluded IDs into `e`, set `M=N−len(e)`, draw eight distinct ranks `r` from `[0,M)`, then map with `r + searchsorted(e−arange(len(e)), r, side='right')`. This bijection preserves uniform sampling without replacement. Alternatively, cache explicit complements when memory permits. NumPy documents [sampling without replacement](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/random/generated/numpy.random.Generator.choice.html) and [binary search](https://numpy.org/doc/1.20/reference/generated/numpy.searchsorted.html). Exclude padding; explicitly handle M<8 rather than looping indefinitely or silently introducing duplicates. Record sampling scope, loss reduction, temperature and RNG seed for reproducibility.
